proposal.selected: Immutable business payload revisions plus intrinsic LifecycleStatus revisions and one current status head per exact business subject. State does not mutate judged business bytes. LifecycleStatus has no lifecycle/acceptance of its own.
proposal.concurrency: Jointly CAS current business head, prior lifecycle head and relevant live validity heads in the same ordered transaction. New business revision initializes status and invalidates old current acceptance; C04 reads current subject/status/dependency closure at use.
